title: From NLG Evaluation to Modern Student Assessment in the Era of ChatGPT: The Great Misalignment Problem and Pedagogical Multi-Factor Assessment (P-MFA)
reasoning: The paper explores pedagogical assessment frameworks and the 'Great Misalignment Problem' in the context of student use of generative AI. It focuses on the epistemology of learning and the validity of evaluation methods rather than benchmarking or evaluating religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
